messages:
elaine-sales: Quick: CitrixBank wants an air-gapped POC. Requirements: signed incremental patches, no outbound network, documented rollback, and key exchange details.

mike-solutions: We can do minibundles (delta-friendly) or full-image swaps. Need to know if they require customer-held signing keys (HSM) or are ok verifying our signatures.

jules-eng: Minibundle = chunked tar + manifest + bundle.sha256. Signed with Notary v2 by default. We can produce AES-256 encrypted bundles too. Apply is offline only.

anya-security: We support customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS). One-liner for questionnaire: "Yes — Redwood supports customer-managed signing keys (HSM/KMS) for offline bundle signing; see attached key-injection runbook."

ops-engr: Transfer ops: recommend sealed USB with `rsync --partial --inplace` and then `sha256sum -c bundle.sha256` on target. If encrypted, we need their envelope-key unwrap method (sneakernet or KMS-wrap).

mike-solutions: Upgrade cadence: propose quarterly deltas (4/yr) + urgent hotfix SLA (48-72h). Pricing rough: POC eng $28k, offline-subscription $20k/yr, HSM integration $6k setup.

elaine-sales: Legal asks: confirm no telemetry leaves site.

jules-eng: Confirmed: offline bundles contain no telemetry or outbound probes. Only local apply logs.

ops-engr: I'll draft a short runbook: verify, apply, verify post-boot, rollback (re-apply previous minibundle). Include checksum and resume steps.

mike-solutions: @ticket-bot please create POC ticket CitrixBank-offline with tags: airgap, customer-hsm, quarterly-patches.

ticket-bot: Created POC-CIT-3190. Assigned to jules-eng. ETA: initial artifact in 5 business days.

elaine-sales: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" — I'll add the one-liner and pricing to the RFP response and attach the runbook when ready.
